_comment: Prototype screens for the Subscription Validity Window & Expiry plan. The plan itself ships NO UI (REQ-060/061); these are visualization prototypes of the future surfaces this backend work unlocks (mySubscriptions expired rendering + the deferred SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED booking-denial arm, ledger D3). Generated for design-alignment discussion only — no prototype fixture data is to be hardcoded into the app.

screens.title: Kottaby - My Subscriptions Dashboard
screens.planRef: REQ-040 / AC4 — in-window subscription: ACTIVE badge, validity window progress, funded lane balances, trial lane separate

screens.title: My Subscriptions — Kottaby Quran Learning
screens.planRef: AC2 / REQ-023/024 — post-sweep: EXPIRED badge, original dates unchanged, subscription lanes zeroed (no carryover), trial balance intact, renew CTA

screens.title: My Subscriptions — Empty State
screens.planRef: Baseline empty state — never-subscribed student; trial credit visible

screens.title: My Subscriptions - Mobile
screens.planRef: Mobile form factor — active + expired cards together, trial chip

screens.title: Kottaby - Book a Session Modal Dialog
screens.planRef: AC3 / REQ-030..034 + deferred-items D3 — SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED denial arm of the booking dialog (deferred to the booking UI's landing); trial credit still offered

screens.title: Kottaby - Session Booked Confirmation
screens.planRef: REQ-033 / INV-B3 — trial-funded booking succeeds despite expired subscription
